item.title: Penghang PHDZ-09 Portable Drying Heater & Clothes Dryer
item.description: Product Overview: The Penghang PHDZ-09 is a high-efficiency, portable electric drying heater designed to quickly dry clothes, shoes, and small fabrics while doubling as a space heater. Perfect for rainy seasons or humid weather, this compact device uses constant temperature heating to dry items gently without damaging delicate fibers. Key Features: PTC Ceramic Heating: Provides fast, stable, and safe heat distribution with low energy consumption. 360° Cycle Drying: Ensures warm air reaches every corner of your drying rack or bag for even results. Anion Sterilization: Helps eliminate bacteria and musty odors from damp clothes, leaving them fresh and sanitized. Overheat Protection: Built-in safety sensor automatically shuts off the device if it exceeds safe temperature limits. Quiet Operation: Designed with noise-reduction technology, making it suitable for use overnight or in quiet environments. Compact & Portable: Lightweight and easy to store, making it ideal for apartments, dorms, or travel. Technical Specifications: Model: PHDZ-09 Power: 800W – 1200W (varies by setting) Voltage: 220V / 50Hz Timing Function: Built-in timer (up to 180 minutes) for worry-free operation. Material: High-temperature resistant flame retardant ABS. Load Capacity: Suitable for drying up to 10–15kg of laundry when used with a drying cover. How to Use: Place the heater under a drying rack or inside a portable drying wardrobe. Ensure the air inlet and outlet are not blocked. Set the desired timer based on the thickness of the fabric. Turn on the device and let the circulating warm air do the work. Package Includes: 1 x Penghang PHDZ-09 Drying Heater, 1 x Remote Control (if applicable), 1 x User Manual.

item.title: Wrist Electronic Sphygmomanometer (BP Device) – Model WEB306
item.description: Wrist Electronic Sphygmomanometer – Model WEB306 Product Overview: The WEB306 is a fully automatic wrist blood pressure monitor designed for fast, reliable, and comfortable home tracking. Equipped with an advanced Intelligent Pressure System, it automatically adjusts inflation levels to suit the user, ensuring a painless and high-precision reading every time. Key Features: IntelliSense Technology: Smart inflation system that prevents over-tightening and ensures clinical-grade accuracy. Large Digital LCD: Extra-large display screen showing Systolic, Diastolic, and Pulse rate simultaneously—perfect for elderly users. Who Indicator: Features a built-in color-coded blood pressure classification bar based on World Health Organization standards. 99-Set Memory: Stores up to 99 previous readings for two separate users, making it easy to track health trends over time. Arrhythmia Detection: Built-in sensor that alerts the user if an irregular heartbeat is detected during measurement. One-Key Operation: Fully automatic "Start/Stop" button for simple, hassle-free use. Technical Specifications: Model: WEB306 (Wrist Type) Measurement Range: Pressure: 0–280 mmHg | Pulse: 40–199 beats/min. Accuracy: Pressure: ±3mmHg | Pulse: ±5%. Cuff Size: Fits wrist circumferences from 13.5cm to 19.5cm. Power: 2 x AAA Batteries (Low power consumption with auto-off feature). How to Use: Secure the cuff around your left wrist, keeping the screen on the inside of your wrist. Sit in a relaxed position with your arm raised so the monitor is at the same level as your heart. Press the "Start" button and remain still until the results appear. Package Includes: 1 x WEB306 Monitor, 1 x Hard Protective Storage Case, 1 x User Manual.

item.title: Tretinoin Gel USP 0.05%
item.description: Tretinoin Gel USP 0.05% is a potent topical retinoid (Vitamin A derivative) primarily used to treat acne, reduce fine wrinkles, and smooth rough skin. It works by increasing skin cell turnover and is best suited for oily or combination skin due to its fast-absorbing, non-greasy formula. It requires a prescription, should be applied at night in a thin layer, and causes high sun sensitivity. Key Details Usage: Used for acne, comedones (blackheads), fine lines, and sun damage. Application: Apply a pea-sized amount to the entire face at night after cleansing, avoiding the eyes, nose, and mouth. Irritation/Purging: Common side effects include peeling, redness, dryness, and irritation. A "purging" period may occur where acne temporarily worsens. Precautions: Highly sensitive to sunlight; strict sunscreen (SPF 30+) use is necessary during the day. Formula Difference: Gel formulations often contain alcohol, making them faster-absorbing than creams, but they can be more drying or cause "pilling" if applied too heavily
